metadata.question: Does forest cover decrease in the area near Banamepe along the Digul River between November 2002 and November 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Banamepe along the Digul River (Papua, Indonesia, approximately -5.5°S, 139.3°E) - Time periods: November 2002 vs November 2019 - Collection: For forest cover over 17 years, I'll use Hansen Global Forest Change (annual data) or Landsat-based NDVI/vegetation indices - Hansen GFC is ideal: has 'treecover2000' and 'lossyear' bands 2. Masking strategy: - Hansen GFC data doesn't need cloud masking (it's already processed) - I'll calculate forest cover in 2002 (baseline) and subtract losses through 2019 - Alternative: Use Landsat NDVI if Hansen fails, with cloud masking 3. Logic to distinguish outcomes: - Valid decrease (A): Forest cover 2019 < Forest cover 2002 by meaningful amount - No decrease (B): Forest cover stable or increased - C1: No data for location - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns null/invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Banamepe area along Digul River, Papua, Indonesia const banamepe = ee.Geometry.Point([139.3, -5.5]); const studyArea = banamepe.buffer(5000); // 5km radius buffer console.log("Analyzing forest cover change near Banamepe, Digul River"); console.log("Study area: 5km radius buffer"); // 2. Load Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // 3. Extract relevant bands const treecover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000'); // Tree cover in year 2000 (%) const lossYear = hansen.select('lossyear'); // Year of forest loss (0-23 for 2000-2023) // 4. Calculate forest cover in 2002 (baseline) // Assume minimal loss between 2000-2002, use 2000 as baseline const forestMask2000 = treecover2000.gte(30); // >= 30% tree cover threshold const forest2002Area = forestMask2000.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); const forest2002Stats = forest2002Area.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: studyArea, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const forest2002 = forest2002Stats.get('treecover2000').getInfo(); // Check for valid data if (forest2002 === null || forest2002 === undefined) { console.log("No forest data available for this location"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Calculate forest loss from 2000 to 2019 // lossYear band: values 1-23 represent years 2001-2023 // For losses through 2019, we need lossYear <= 19 const lossThrough2019 = lossYear.gte(1).and(lossYear.lte(19)); const lostForest = forestMask2000.and(lossThrough2019); const lostArea = lostForest.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); const lossStats = lostArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: studyArea, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const lostForestArea = lossStats.get('lossyear').getInfo(); // 6. Calculate remaining forest in 2019 const forest2019 = forest2002 - (lostForestArea || 0); // 7. Count valid pixels const pixelCount = forestMask2000.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: studyArea, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('treecover2000').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in study area"); console.log("C2"); return; } // 8. Print results const forest2002Ha = (forest2002 / 10000).toFixed(2); const forest2019Ha = (forest2019 / 10000).toFixed(2); const lossHa = ((lostForestArea || 0) / 10000).toFixed(2); const lossPercent = ((lostForestArea || 0) / forest2002 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Forest 2002: ${forest2002Ha} ha`); console.log(`Forest loss 2002-2019: ${lossHa} ha`); console.log(`Forest 2019: ${forest2019Ha} ha`); console.log(`Loss percentage: ${lossPercent}%`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); // 9. Determine answer if (forest2002 === null || forest2019 === null || isNaN(forest2002) || isNaN(forest2019)) { console.log("Calculation returned invalid values"); console.log("C3"); } else if (lostForestArea > 0 && forest2019 < forest2002) { console.log("Forest cover decreased"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("No significant forest decrease detected"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
